id.description: Unique identifier of the template item.

items.description: Project Action Plan Template Item Assignee (Compact)

created_at.description: Time the Project Action Plan Template Item Assignee was created

is_holding.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the assignee is necessary to sign for a hold point

role.description: Role of the Project Action Plan Template Item Assignee

created_at.description: Timestamp when the template item was created. ISO 8601 format.

due_at.description: Deadline for the template item. Null if no due date is set. ISO 8601 format.

description.description: Acceptance criteria or additional details describing what this item requires.

holding_type.description: Determines the scope of the hold point. 'plan' holds all succeeding items in the entire plan; 'section' holds only items in the same section.

plan_template_id.description: Unique identifier of the parent Action Plan Template.

position.description: Position of the template item within its section. Lower values appear first.

plan_template_section_id.description: Unique identifier of the section this item belongs to.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the template item was last modified. ISO 8601 format.

plan_template_item_id.description: ID of the Action Plan Template Item to copy from.
